name: Archive Project
summary: Archive a completed or inactive project and free its assigned agents.

steps.note: Say: 'Archive <PROJECT_NAME>? All assigned agents will be freed.' Wait for yes.
Propose: reassign freed agents, review remaining open tasks

notes: Archive is reversible — set status back to 'active' via update_field
Project folder stays at aquarium/PROJECTS/<slug>/ — data is never deleted
All assigned agents are automatically freed and return to 'sleeping' status
